_about: Public-domain Walter Rauschenbusch (1861-1918, Rochester Baptist, prophet of the Social Gospel) for the Word Hoard: Christianity and the Social Crisis (1907), Prayers of the Social Awakening (1910), Christianizing the Social Order (1912), Unto Me (1912), Dare We Be Christians (1914), The Social Principles of Jesus (1916) and A Theology for the Social Gospel (1917), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
